name: @kitora/whiteboard
description: Kitora's whiteboard: an SVG infinite canvas (shapes, freehand, select / move / resize / rotate, groups, z-order, undo, SVG / PNG / JSON) on a framework-free pointer engine, plus a mind map and an org chart on the same camera and tree layout.

exports.name: rotateAround
exports.description: `p` rotated by `angle` radians around `origin`.
exports.signature: (p: Point, origin: Point, angle: number) => Point

exports.name: boxFromPoints
exports.description: A box from two corners in any order (a drag from `a` to `b`).

exports.name: boundsOfPoints
exports.description: The smallest box around `points`; a zero box at the origin when there are none.

exports.name: unionBoxes
exports.description: The union of boxes, or null for none.

exports.name: corners
exports.description: The four corners of `b` rotated by `angle` around its centre, clockwise from top-left.

exports.name: distToSegment
exports.description: Distance from `p` to the segment `a`–`b`.
exports.signature: (p: Point, a: Point, b: Point) => number

exports.name: distToPolyline
exports.description: Distance from `p` to an open polyline; Infinity for an empty one.

exports.name: normalizeAngle
exports.description: Normalise an angle to (-π, π].

exports.name: Point
exports.description: A point in world units (or screen pixels, where a function says so).

exports.name: Box
exports.description: An axis-aligned box: top-left corner plus size.

exports.name: point
exports.description: Make a point from `x` and `y`.

exports.name: add
exports.description: The sum `a + b`.

exports.name: sub
exports.description: The difference `a - b`.

exports.name: scale
exports.description: `a` multiplied by `k`.

exports.name: dist
exports.description: The straight-line distance between `a` and `b`.

exports.name: center
exports.description: The centre of box `b`.

exports.name: rotatedBounds
exports.description: The axis-aligned box around `b` once rotated by `angle` around its centre.

exports.name: boxContainsPoint
exports.description: Whether `p` lies inside `b` (edges included).

exports.name: boxContainsBox
exports.description: Whether `inner` lies wholly inside `outer`.

exports.name: boxesIntersect
exports.description: Whether boxes `a` and `b` overlap or touch.

exports.name: snapAngle
exports.description: Snap an angle (radians) to the nearest multiple of `step`.

exports.name: round2
exports.description: Round to 2 decimals, so saved documents and exported SVG stay short.

exports.name: worldPoints
exports.description: World points of a path shape (rotation applied).

exports.name: pathFromWorld
exports.description:
A path shape from world points: the box becomes their bounds and the points go local. Used by the
line, arrow and draw tools, and when an endpoint is dragged.
exports.signature: <S extends PathShape>(s: S, world: readonly Point[]) => S

exports.name: hitShape
exports.description:
Does world point `p` hit shape `s`? `tolerance` is in world units (the caller divides its pixel
tolerance by the zoom). Filled box shapes hit inside; unfilled rects and ellipses hit near the outline
or anywhere inside (power users click inside an empty frame to grab it), path shapes near the path.
exports.signature: (s: Shape, p: Point, tolerance: number) => boolean

exports.name: defaultCreateId
exports.description: Next shape id: a short random suffix. Hosts swap it through the store's `createId` option.

exports.name: createShape
exports.description: A shape from friendly input (defaults filled in), for seeding boards from data.

exports.name: SHAPE_KINDS
exports.description: Every kind of shape, in toolbar order.

exports.name: ShapeKind
exports.description: One kind of shape (`SHAPE_KINDS`).

exports.name: PATH_KINDS
exports.description: Kinds drawn as a path through `points`.

exports.name: PathKind
exports.description: A shape kind drawn as a path: line, arrow or draw.

exports.name: TEXT_KINDS
exports.description: Kinds that hold editable text.

exports.name: TEXT_ALIGNS
exports.description: Every horizontal text alignment, in the order the style panel shows them.

exports.name: TextAlign
exports.description: How a shape's text lines up horizontally: start, middle or end.

exports.name: DASH_STYLES
exports.description: Every stroke dash style, in the order the style panel shows them.

exports.name: DashStyle
exports.description: How a shape's stroke is drawn: solid, dashed or dotted.

exports.name: ShapeStyle
exports.description: Paint for one shape. Colours are any CSS colour; "none" means no fill.

exports.name: DEFAULT_STYLE
exports.description: The style new shapes get unless the host passes its own.

exports.name: STICKY_COLORS
exports.description: Sticky-note paper colours offered by the style panel.

exports.name: BoxShape
exports.description: A shape drawn from its box: rect, ellipse, diamond, text or sticky note.

exports.name: PathShape
exports.description: A line, arrow or freehand drawing: a path through `points` inside its box.

exports.name: Shape
exports.description: Any whiteboard shape: a box shape or a path shape.

exports.name: isPathShape
exports.description: Whether `s` is a path shape (line, arrow or draw).

exports.name: isPathKind
exports.description: Whether kind `k` is a path kind (line, arrow or draw).

exports.name: holdsText
exports.description: Whether shape `s` can hold text (every box shape).

exports.name: MIN_SIZE
exports.description: The minimum side a box shape keeps while resizing, in world units.

exports.name: shapeBox
exports.description: The shape's unrotated box.

exports.name: shapeBounds
exports.description: The axis-aligned world bounds of a shape, rotation included.

exports.name: shapeCenter
exports.description: The centre of the shape's box, which it rotates around.

exports.name: toLocal
exports.description: `p` (world) in the shape's unrotated frame, so tests can treat the shape as axis-aligned.

exports.name: ShapeInput
exports.description: What `createShape` takes: a box for box kinds, world points for path kinds.

exports.name: shapesInOrder
exports.description: Shapes in paint order.

exports.name: docFromShapes
exports.description: Build a document from shapes, painted in the order given (first = bottom).

exports.name: addShapes
exports.description: Add shapes on top of the paint order; a shape whose id already exists is replaced and moved to the top.

exports.name: updateShapes
exports.description: Replace shapes by id; ids not in the document are ignored.

exports.name: mapShapes
exports.description: Apply `fn` to each listed shape.
exports.signature: (doc: BoardDoc, ids: Iterable<string>, fn: (s: Shape) => Shape) => BoardDoc

exports.name: removeShapes
exports.description: Remove the shapes with these ids.

exports.name: reorder
exports.description:
Reorder the selected shapes. `forward` / `backward` step each selected shape one place past its
nearest unselected neighbour, keeping the selection's own relative order; `toFront` / `toBack` move
the whole selection to an end.
exports.signature: (doc: BoardDoc, ids: ReadonlySet<string>, move: ZMove) => BoardDoc

exports.name: expandGroups
exports.description: Ids of every shape in the same groups as `ids` (a click on one grouped shape selects its group).

exports.name: group
exports.description: Put the listed shapes in one new group (an existing group among them is absorbed).
exports.signature: (doc: BoardDoc, ids: ReadonlySet<string>, groupId: string) => BoardDoc

exports.name: ungroup
exports.description: Take the listed shapes out of their groups.

exports.name: BoardDoc
exports.description: The board document: shapes by id plus their paint order. Every operation returns a new document.

exports.name: EMPTY_DOC
exports.description: A document with no shapes.

exports.name: Z_MOVES
exports.description: The four z-order moves, as named in menus.

exports.name: ZMove
exports.description: One z-order move (`Z_MOVES`): to front, forward, backward or to back.

exports.name: pushHistory
exports.description: Record `next` as a new step; the redo branch is dropped. A no-op when nothing changed.
exports.signature: <T>(h: History<T>, next: T, limit?: number) => History<T>

exports.name: undo
exports.description: Step back one snapshot; unchanged when there is nothing to undo.

exports.name: redo
exports.description: Step forward one undone snapshot; unchanged when there is nothing to redo.

exports.name: History
exports.description: Undo and redo stacks around the current snapshot.

exports.name: DEFAULT_HISTORY_LIMIT
exports.description: How many undo steps are kept unless the host asks for more.

exports.name: createHistory
exports.description: Start a history at `present` with nothing to undo or redo.

exports.name: replacePresent
exports.description: Replace the present without recording a step (live drag frames).

exports.name: canUndo
exports.description: Whether there is a step to undo.

exports.name: canRedo
exports.description: Whether there is a step to redo.

exports.name: streamlinePoint
exports.description: The next live point: `input` pulled towards the previous point by `streamline`.
exports.signature: (prev: Point | undefined, input: Point, streamline?: number) => Point

exports.name: simplify
exports.description: Ramer–Douglas–Peucker: drop points closer than `tolerance` to the line through their neighbours.

exports.name: smoothPath
exports.description:
An SVG path `d` through `points`: straight for one or two points, quadratic curves through the
midpoints otherwise. A single point becomes a dot (a zero-length segment, drawn by a round cap).

exports.name: DEFAULT_STREAMLINE
exports.description: Live smoothing weight: 0 = raw input, closer to 1 = heavier lag and smoother line.

exports.name: DEFAULT_SIMPLIFY_TOLERANCE
exports.description: RDP tolerance in world units when a stroke ends.

exports.name: zoomAt
exports.description: Zoom to `zoom` keeping the world point under screen point `at` fixed.
exports.signature: (c: Camera, at: Point, zoom: number, limits?: ZoomLimits) => Camera

exports.name: fitBounds
exports.description: A camera that shows `bounds` centred in a `viewport`-sized screen with `padding` pixels around.
exports.signature: (bounds: Box, viewport: { readonly w: number; readonly h: number; }, padding?: number, limits?: ZoomLimits) => Camera

exports.name: visibleWorld
exports.description: The world box the viewport currently shows.
exports.signature: (c: Camera, viewport: { readonly w: number; readonly h: number; }) => Box

exports.name: Camera
exports.description: A viewport over the infinite plane: a pan offset in screen pixels and a zoom factor.

exports.name: DEFAULT_CAMERA
exports.description: The starting camera: no pan, zoom 1.

exports.name: ZoomLimits
exports.description: The smallest and largest zoom a camera may reach.

exports.name: DEFAULT_ZOOM_LIMITS
exports.description: Zoom limits used when none are given: 10% to 800%.

exports.name: ZOOM_STEP
exports.description: Zoom factor per button press / keyboard step.

exports.name: screenToWorld
exports.description: Convert a screen point (pixels) to a world point under camera `c`.

exports.name: worldToScreen
exports.description: Convert a world point to a screen point (pixels) under camera `c`.

exports.name: clampZoom
exports.description: Clamp `zoom` into `limits`.

exports.name: panBy
exports.description: Move the camera by `dx`, `dy` screen pixels.
exports.signature: (c: Camera, dx: number, dy: number) => Camera

exports.name: centerOn
exports.description: A camera that puts world point `p` at the centre of the viewport, keeping the zoom.
exports.signature: (c: Camera, p: Point, viewport: { readonly w: number; readonly h: number; }) => Camera

exports.name: handlePoint
exports.description: World position of a handle on a box rotated by `rotation`.
exports.signature: (box: Box, rotation: number, handle: ResizeHandle) => Point

exports.name: resizeBox
exports.description:
The new unrotated box when `handle` of `box` is dragged to `local` (pointer already in the box's
unrotated frame). The opposite side stays put; sides never cross (they stop at MIN_SIZE). With
`keepAspect` a corner scales both sides by the larger factor.
exports.signature: (box: Box, handle: ResizeHandle, local: Point, keepAspect: boolean) => Box

exports.name: resizeShape
exports.description:
Resize one shape by a handle, honouring its rotation: the pointer is taken into the shape's frame,
the box resized there, and the new centre placed so the opposite handle does not move on screen.
exports.signature: (s: Shape, handle: ResizeHandle, pointer: Point, keepAspect: boolean) => Shape

exports.name: resizeSelection
exports.description: Resize a selection by its axis-aligned bounds: every shape's centre and size scale with the box.
exports.signature: (shapes: readonly Shape[], handle: ResizeHandle, pointer: Point, keepAspect: boolean) => Shape[]

exports.name: rotateShapes
exports.description: Rotate shapes around `pivot` by `delta` radians: centres orbit, each shape turns by the same amount.
exports.signature: (shapes: readonly Shape[], pivot: Point, delta: number) => Shape[]

exports.name: rotationDelta
exports.description: The rotation delta for a rotate drag from `start` to `pointer` around `pivot`, snapped with Shift.
exports.signature: (pivot: Point, start: Point, pointer: Point, base: number, snap: boolean) => number

exports.name: moveEndpoint
exports.description: Move endpoint `index` (0 = start, last = end) of a line or arrow to world point `to`.
exports.signature: (s: PathShape, index: number, to: Point) => PathShape

exports.name: snapToAngle
exports.description: Snap `p` around `origin` to the nearest 45° ray (Shift while drawing a line).

exports.name: dragBox
exports.description: The box a box tool draws from `origin` to `p`; with `square` (Shift) the box is square.
exports.signature: (origin: Point, p: Point, square: boolean) => Box

exports.name: RESIZE_HANDLES
exports.description: The eight resize handles, by compass point.

exports.name: ResizeHandle
exports.description: One of the eight resize handles, named by compass point.

exports.name: HANDLE_DIR
exports.description: Unit direction of each handle from the box centre.

exports.name: HANDLE_CURSOR
exports.description: CSS cursor per handle for an unrotated box.

exports.name: ROTATE_SNAP
exports.description: Rotation snaps to this step while Shift is held.

exports.name: selectionBounds
exports.description: The axis-aligned bounds of several shapes, or null for none.

exports.name: moveShapes
exports.description: Translate shapes by `delta`.

exports.name: constrainAxis
exports.description: Lock a drag delta to its dominant axis (Shift while moving).

exports.name: wrapText
exports.description:
Wrap `text` into lines no wider than `maxWidth`. Hard newlines always break; a word longer than the
line is split by characters. `maxWidth` of Infinity only breaks on newlines (free text).
exports.signature: (text: string, maxWidth: number, fontSize: number, measurer?: TextMeasurer) => string[]

exports.name: measureBlock
exports.description: The width and height a block of free text takes (the text tool sizes its box with it).
exports.signature: (text: string, fontSize: number, measurer?: TextMeasurer) => { readonly w: number; readonly h: number; }

exports.name: TextMeasurer
exports.description: Measures the rendered width of `text` at `fontSize` pixels.

exports.name: estimateMeasurer
exports.description: A DOM-free estimate: good enough for tests and server rendering, replaced in the browser.

exports.name: LINE_HEIGHT
exports.description: Line height as a multiple of the font size.

exports.name: dashArray
exports.description: `stroke-dasharray` for a dash style, scaled by stroke width.

exports.name: arrowHead
exports.description: The arrowhead triangle at `tip`, pointing away from `from`.
exports.signature: (from: Point, tip: Point, strokeWidth: number) => readonly Point[]

exports.name: describeShape
exports.description: The SVG description of one shape: a group carrying rotation and opacity around its body and text.

exports.name: SvgAttrs
exports.description: SVG attributes of one element, by attribute name.

exports.name: SvgNode
exports.description: One SVG element: a primitive, a text block (one tspan per line) or a group.

exports.name: TEXT_PADDING
exports.description: Inner padding of text inside rects, ellipses and stickies.

exports.name: nodeToSvg
exports.description: One SVG node as markup.

exports.name: exportBounds
exports.description: The world box an export covers (content bounds plus padding), or null for an empty board.
exports.signature: (shapes: readonly Shape[], padding?: number) => Box | null

exports.name: exportSvg
exports.description: The board as a standalone SVG document. An empty board gives a 1×1 empty SVG.

exports.name: SvgExportOptions
exports.description: Options for SVG export: which shapes, padding, background, text measuring and a custom shape description.

exports.name: serializeBoard
exports.description: Serialise the document (and optionally the camera) as a `BoardFile` JSON string.

exports.name: parseShape
exports.description: One shape from untrusted JSON, or an error message naming what is wrong.

exports.name: parseBoard
exports.description: Parse a saved board. Never throws: a broken file comes back as `{ ok: false, error }`.

exports.name: BOARD_FORMAT_VERSION
exports.description: The file format version this build writes.

exports.name: BOARD_FORMAT
exports.description: The `format` tag every saved board file carries.

exports.name: BoardFile
exports.description: A saved board as JSON: format tag, version, shapes in paint order and an optional camera.

exports.name: BoardStorage
exports.description: Where boards are saved: a key-value store of serialised boards. Async so a server fits.

exports.name: ParseResult
exports.description: The result of parsing a board file: the document and camera, or an error message.

exports.name: BOARD_COMMANDS
exports.description: Every command the board answers, beyond pointer gestures.

exports.name: BoardCommand
exports.description: A named board action (`BOARD_COMMANDS`) a key or button can run, such as `undo` or `tool:rect`.

exports.name: Keymap
exports.description: Bindings per command, in the keyboard kit's grammar. `Mod` is ⌘ on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere.

exports.name: DEFAULT_KEYMAP
exports.description: The board's built-in key bindings.

exports.name: selectionFrame
exports.description: The box and rotation the selection chrome draws around, or null with nothing selected.
exports.signature: (shapes: readonly Shape[]) => { readonly box: Box; readonly rotation: number; } | null

exports.name: rotateKnob
exports.description: Where the rotate knob sits for a frame at `zoom`.
exports.signature: (frame: { readonly box: Box; readonly rotation: number; }, zoom: number) => Point

exports.name: createBoardStore
exports.description: Create a framework-free board engine (document, history, selection, camera, tool and pointer state machine).

exports.name: TOOLS
exports.description: Every tool, in toolbar order.

exports.name: Tool
exports.description: One of the board's tools (`TOOLS`): select, hand, a shape kind, text, sticky or the pen.

exports.name: HANDLE_PX
exports.description: Screen-pixel sizes of the selection chrome; the hit test divides them by the zoom.

exports.name: ROTATE_OFFSET_PX
exports.description: How far the rotate knob sits above the selection's top edge, in screen pixels.

exports.name: HIT_TOLERANCE_PX
exports.description: How close (screen pixels) the pointer must come to a thin shape or a handle to hit it.

exports.name: CLICK_SIZES
exports.description: Sizes a click (no drag) gives each creating tool, in world units.

exports.name: FIT_PADDING_PX
exports.description: Room left around content by "zoom to fit", clear of the floating controls.

exports.name: CLICK_SLOP_PX
exports.description: A drag shorter than this (screen px) counts as a click.

exports.name: PASTE_OFFSET
exports.description: Pasted and duplicated shapes land this far from their source.

exports.name: BoardTarget
exports.description: What the pointer is over.

exports.name: Interaction
exports.description: The gesture in progress. Snapshots are the shapes as they were when it began.

props.name: history
props.description: The document with its undo and redo stacks; `present` is the current document.

props.name: selection
props.description: Ids of the selected shapes.

props.name: camera
props.description: The viewport's pan and zoom.

props.name: tool
props.description: The active tool.

props.name: toolLocked
props.description: Keep the tool after creating a shape (the toolbar lock).

props.name: style
props.description: Style for new shapes; the style panel also applies it to the selection.

props.name: interaction
props.description: The pointer gesture in progress, `idle` between gestures.

props.name: editingId
props.description: The shape whose text is being edited, or null.

props.name: hover
props.description: What the idle pointer is over, for the cursor and hover outline.

exports.name: BoardPointer
exports.description: One pointer event in board terms.

exports.name: BoardOptions
exports.description: Options for `createBoardStore`: the starting document, camera, tool and style, plus id, measuring and policy hooks.

exports.name: BoardListener
exports.description: Called after every board state change, with the new state and the one before it.

exports.name: BoardStore
exports.description: The board engine `createBoardStore` returns: read and subscribe to its state, feed it pointer events, and run commands.

exports.name: layoutTree
exports.description:
Lay out one tree. The root's top-left (down) or left-middle (right/left) sits at the origin side;
call `translateLayout` to move it. Collapsed subtrees are simply not returned by `children`.
exports.signature: <N>(root: N, access: TreeAccess<N>, options?: Partial<TreeLayoutOptions>) => TreeLayout

exports.name: translateLayout
exports.description: Move every node and link by `d`.

exports.name: layoutMindMap
exports.description:
A balanced mind map: the root's children split into a right and a left half by subtree size
(first half right, as most tools do), each laid out sideways, the root centred between them.
exports.signature: <N>(root: N, access: TreeAccess<N>, options?: Partial<Omit<TreeLayoutOptions, "direction">> & { readonly balanced?: boolean; }) => TreeLayout

exports.name: nearestInDirection
exports.description:
The node an arrow key moves to: the nearest laid-out node whose centre lies in that direction,
favouring nodes straight ahead over nodes off to the side. Null at the edge.
exports.signature: (layout: TreeLayout, fromId: string, dir: NavDirection) => string | null

exports.name: linkPath
exports.description: A smooth link path: a cubic curve leaving and reaching along the layout's main axis.

exports.name: elbowPath
exports.description: An elbow link (org charts): down, across, down.

exports.name: TREE_DIRECTIONS
exports.description: Every direction a tree can grow.

exports.name: TreeDirection
exports.description: Which way a tree grows from its root: `down` for org charts, `right` or `left` for mind maps.

exports.name: TreeAccess
exports.description: How the layout reads a tree; any node shape fits.

exports.name: TreeLayoutOptions
exports.description: How a tree is laid out: its direction and the gaps between nodes.

exports.name: DEFAULT_TREE_LAYOUT
exports.description: The layout used when none is given: growing down, 16 between siblings, 48 between levels.

exports.name: LaidNode
exports.description: One node's placed box in a tree layout.

exports.name: TreeLink
exports.description: A parent-to-child connector in a tree layout.

exports.name: TreeLayout
exports.description: A laid-out tree: every visible node's box, the links between them, and the whole extent.

exports.name: NAV_DIRECTIONS
exports.description: Every direction arrow-key navigation can move in.

exports.name: NavDirection
exports.description: An arrow-key direction for moving between tree nodes.

exports.name: findMindNode
exports.description: The node with this id, or null when the map has none.

exports.name: mindPath
exports.description: The chain of ids from the root to `id` (inclusive), or [] when absent.

exports.name: updateMindNode
exports.description: Apply `fn` to the node `id`; untouched branches keep their identity.
exports.signature: (root: MindNode, id: string, fn: (n: MindNode) => MindNode) => MindNode

exports.name: addMindSibling
exports.description: Add `sibling` right after `id`. Adding a sibling to the root adds a child instead.
exports.signature: (root: MindNode, id: string, sibling: MindNode) => MindNode

exports.name: removeMindNode
exports.description: Remove `id` and its subtree. The root cannot be removed.

exports.name: focusAfterRemove
exports.description: The node to focus after `id` is removed: next sibling, else previous, else the parent.

exports.name: mindAccess
exports.description: The tree accessor the layout needs, sizing topics by their text.
exports.signature: (root: MindNode, sizing?: MindSizing, measurer?: TextMeasurer) => TreeAccess<MindNode>

exports.name: branchColors
exports.description:
The colour each node draws with: the root's children take the palette in turn unless they set
their own, and every descendant inherits its branch colour unless it sets one.
exports.signature: (root: MindNode, palette?: readonly string[], rootColor?: string) => Map<string, string>

exports.name: MindNode
exports.description: One topic of a mind map, with its child topics; the root node is the whole map.

exports.name: mindParentId
exports.description: The id of the parent of `id`, or null for the root or an absent id.

exports.name: addMindChild
exports.description: Add `child` as the last child of `parentId` and expand the parent.
exports.signature: (root: MindNode, parentId: string, child: MindNode) => MindNode

exports.name: toggleMindNode
exports.description: Fold or unfold the branch `id`; a leaf is left as it is.

exports.name: renameMindNode
exports.description: Set the text of node `id`.
exports.signature: (root: MindNode, id: string, text: string) => MindNode

exports.name: descendantCount
exports.description: Count of every node under `n` (collapsed or not), for the "+3" badge on a folded branch.

exports.name: MindSizing
exports.description: Topic box sizes: the root is larger; widths follow the text.

exports.name: DEFAULT_MIND_SIZING
exports.description: Topic sizes used when none are given.

exports.name: MIND_PALETTE
exports.description: Branch colours the mind map cycles through for the root's children.

exports.name: buildOrgForest
exports.description:
Build the forest from a flat list. A person whose manager is missing becomes a root, and a manager
cycle is broken at the first person met again, so bad HR data still renders.

exports.name: managersOf
exports.description: Ids of everyone above `id`, nearest manager first.

exports.name: searchOrg
exports.description: People matching `query` (case-insensitive, every word must hit some field). Empty query → [].
exports.signature: <T extends OrgPerson>(people: readonly T[], query: string, fields?: (p: T) => readonly (string | undefined)[]) => string[]

exports.name: revealInOrg
exports.description: The collapsed set with every manager of `ids` expanded, so all hits are visible.
exports.signature: (people: readonly OrgPerson[], collapsed: ReadonlySet<string>, ids: readonly string[]) => Set<string>

exports.name: orgAccess
exports.description: Tree accessor for the layout: fixed card size, collapsed managers hide their reports.
exports.signature: <T extends OrgPerson>(collapsed: ReadonlySet<string>, card: { readonly w: number; readonly h: number; }) => TreeAccess<OrgNode<T>>

exports.name: OrgPerson
exports.description: One person. Extra fields ride along in `T` for the card renderer.

exports.name: OrgNode
exports.description: One person in the org tree `buildOrgForest` builds, with their direct reports.

exports.name: reportCount
exports.description: Number of people under `node`, at any depth.

exports.name: ORG_ROOT_ID
exports.description: A virtual root above a forest, so several top people lay out as one tree.

exports.name: canvasMeasurer
exports.description: A text measurer that reads real glyph widths from a 2D canvas; the core estimate where no canvas exists.

exports.name: pageFontMeasurer
exports.description: A measurer in the page's own font (the mind map and org chart draw their text as HTML).

exports.name: BOARD_FONT
exports.description: The font stack the default shape renderer draws text with.

exports.name: svgToPng
exports.description: Rasterise an SVG document to a PNG blob at `scale` × its intrinsic size (2 = retina).
exports.signature: (svg: string, options?: { readonly scale?: number; readonly background?: string; }) => Promise<Blob>

exports.name: downloadBlob
exports.description: Offer `blob` as a download named `filename`.

exports.name: pickFile
exports.description: Let the user pick one file; resolves null when the picker is dismissed.

exports.name: downloadText
exports.description: Save `text` as a download named `filename`, with MIME `type`.
exports.signature: (text: string, filename: string, type?: string) => void

exports.name: PickedFile
exports.description: What "Open…" hands back: anything that can be read as text (a `File`, a fetched body, a stub).

exports.name: BoardFiles
exports.description:
The file seam behind every export and "Open…": how an SVG becomes a PNG, where a finished file
goes, and where an opened one comes from. `browserBoardFiles` (the default) rasterises with a 2D
canvas, saves through a download link and opens with a file picker; a host swaps the whole object
to upload exports to its server, write through the File System Access API, or capture them in tests.
